Oncology Services
The Animal Cancer Center of Texas provides expert care for dogs and cats with many types of cancers, including but not limited to:
Lymphoma
Mast cell tumor
Hemangiosarcoma
Osteosarcoma
Soft tissue sarcomas and fibrosarcomas
Transitional cell carcinoma
Anal gland adenocarcinoma
Histiocytic sarcoma
Mammary gland carcinoma
Malignant melanoma
Many other types of carcinomas and sarcomas
We also offer various treatment modalities for your pet’s specific cancer.  The treatments that we recommend are based upon the cancer type, cancer stage, and your pet’s overall health.
Surgery (transfer to board-certified surgeon)
Discussion and referral for radiation therapy
Chemotherapy
Immunotherapy
Targeted therapy
Pain management
Palliative treatment
End-of-life care
The Animal Cancer Center of Texas strives to provide state-of-the-art diagnostics in order to obtain the most information possible regarding your pet’s cancer. Our diagnostic tools help to secure a definitive cancer diagnosis, supply information on prognosis, monitor the safety of your pet’s cancer treatment, monitor your pet’s response to treatment, and evaluate for any cancer recurrence or metastasis. The diagnostic tools available include:
Blood and urine testing
Advanced genetic and molecular testing
Fine needle aspirates and cytology
Biopsy
Radiographs
Ultrasound
CT scan
